names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 6602, «Малх Сирийский, прп.», with the rank word left off. The day’s own line declines it, «Прп. Малха Сирийского (IV)».

death.note: The century the calendar closes both the day line and the life with, and the only date either gives: «Прп. Малха Сирийского (IV)» and «мирно скончался (IV)». It gives him no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Малха Сирийского (IV)»

attestations.note: Name page 6602 gives «День памяти: 26 марта» and nothing else, so no second day is owed. The corpus already holds a folder `malchus` off saint.gr’s «Όσιος Μάλχος» on the Greek 24 November, whose entry says in one sentence that nothing further is known of him — no country, no century, no monastery. The two were NOT identified here: the days are not the same and are not thirteen apart, and the Greek entry carries nothing by which a reading could be made. That is a question for the author and not a folder’s to settle. The day page carries three hymns and all three are the Archangel Gabriel’s; none is his. azbyka.ru was not read.
